claims.content: Authorize a System Administrator to create and modify system configuration data, including staff, devices, and scheduled operations.

goal.raw_text: Authorize a System Administrator to create and modify system configuration data, including staff, devices, and scheduled operations.

claims.content: System Administrator
The user is logged on to the RLCS Application as a System Administrator.
The System Administrator has been assigned a security level and password.
The System Administrator initiates the configuration of staff access permissions by selecting the option to assign or modify security levels and passwords for defined staff members via the GUI.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator initiates the configuration of staff access permissions by selecting the option to assign or modify security levels and passwords for defined staff members via the GUI.

claims.content: The System Administrator selects the configuration option to assign or modify security levels and passwords for defined staff members.
The GUI displays the list of defined staff members and allows the administrator to select a specific staff member for modification.
The System Administrator assigns or modifies the security level for the selected staff member at the command level, device, mode, workstation, and system function as needed.
If changing user account details remotely in field units, the System Administrator initiates the remote change via the configuration option.
When making changes that affect devices, controllers, or workstations in the RLCS network, the GUI displays to the user which components will be affected by the changes.
The System Administrator confirms the changes, and the system updates the database tables accordingly.
Before storing modified data in the database, the GUI analyzes the data for any conflicting or redundant entries and notifies the System Administrator if such entries are found.
Upon successful validation and storage, the system confirms the update to the System Administrator.
If the GUI detects conflicting or redundant entries when analyzing modified database table data before storage, it notifies the System Administrator and halts the update until resolved.
If the System Administrator attempts to configure device rules without providing the additional required login password for that option, the system denies access to that configuration function.
A security level and password have been assigned to the defined staff member.
User security levels have been assigned at the command level, device, mode, workstation, and system function as configured by the System Administrator.
If applicable, user accounts have been changed remotely in the field units.
The database tables have been updated with the new or modified staff access permissions after analysis for conflicting or redundant entries.
The System Administrator has been notified of any conflicting or redundant entries detected during data analysis prior to storage (if any were found and resolved).
